findings.highlight: I’d probably collapse from fever if I actually talk about it
findings.evidenceJa: 口にしたらそれこそ熱でぶっ倒れる
findings.governingReading: if he said the dream aloud, the heat would make him collapse
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds probability and medicalizes embarrassed heat as fever.

findings.highlight: No one was in my dream
findings.evidenceJa: 別に誰も出てきてない
findings.governingReading: no one in particular appeared
findings.explanation: Shirou’s evasive “no one in particular” becomes the stronger and plainly false assertion that nobody appeared.

findings.highlight: you forget about your dreams once you wake up
findings.evidenceJa: 目が覚めた途端に忘れる
findings.governingReading: dreams are forgotten the instant one wakes
findings.explanation: The English removes the immediate transition that supports Shirou’s excuse.

findings.highlight: I don’t remember all of it
findings.evidenceJa: いつまでも覚えてないっていうか
findings.governingReading: one does not keep remembering a dream indefinitely
findings.explanation: Duration becomes incomplete recall, changing the shape of Shirou’s evasive claim.

findings.highlight: You idiot…!
findings.evidenceJa: ばっ……！
findings.governingReading: an interrupted “ba—” exclamation
findings.explanation: mirror moon completes Shirou’s cut-off sound as a direct insult to Sakura.

findings.highlight: Sakura came close to me, but she draws near me
findings.evidenceJa: 布団から退避した俺に詰め寄ってくる桜
findings.governingReading: Sakura presses in on Shirou after he has evacuated the futon
findings.explanation: The English redundantly describes approach while omitting Shirou’s retreat and Sakura closing the distance on him.

findings.highlight: I’m sorry
findings.evidenceJa: 頼むから勘弁してくれ
findings.governingReading: please, give him a break or spare him
findings.explanation: A desperate request for Sakura to stop becomes an apology.

findings.highlight: I wave my hand
findings.evidenceJa: ぶんぶんと手を振りながら
findings.governingReading: while waving his hands vigorously back and forth
findings.explanation: The English removes the intensity and reduces the frantic gesture to one hand.

findings.highlight: roll further down the tatami
findings.evidenceJa: さらに畳を転がっていく
findings.governingReading: continues rolling away across the tatami
findings.explanation: The English gives the flat flooring a downward direction and drops the evasive relation.

findings.highlight: I can usually ignore them
findings.evidenceJa: いつもは意識しないでいられる
findings.governingReading: normally he can remain without consciously noticing Sakura’s every movement
findings.explanation: mirror moon changes an absence of heightened awareness into active suppression and leaves “them” weakly anchored.

findings.highlight: Don’t you have to obey a sick person’s requests
findings.evidenceJa: 病人の願いは聞くべき
findings.governingReading: one ought to grant or listen to a sick person’s wish
findings.explanation: The English turns a plea for consideration into an authority claim demanding obedience.

findings.highlight: Sitting in the corner of the room
findings.evidenceJa: 部屋の隅に陣取って
findings.governingReading: taking up a defensive position in the corner of the room
findings.explanation: The English removes the mock-military force of Shirou establishing himself in the corner.

findings.highlight: I won’t force it out of you
findings.evidenceJa: 無理には聞きません
findings.governingReading: she will not force herself to ask
findings.explanation: The English shifts coercion from Sakura pressing the question to extracting information from Shirou.

findings.highlight: your fever might get worse
findings.evidenceJa: 熱が上がっちゃいます
findings.governingReading: his fever will rise
findings.explanation: A specific rise in temperature becomes generic worsening and gains uncertainty.

findings.highlight: Sakura backs down
findings.evidenceJa: 桜は残念そうに後退する
findings.governingReading: Sakura retreats looking disappointed
findings.explanation: mirror moon removes both physical direction and Sakura’s disappointment.

findings.highlight: I quickly climb back into my futon
findings.evidenceJa: いそいそと布団に戻る
findings.governingReading: Shirou eagerly or busily returns to the futon
findings.explanation: Speed replaces his almost cheerful eagerness, and “climb” adds a new motion.

findings.highlight: I need to go cook lunch
findings.evidenceJa: お昼の支度があります
findings.governingReading: she has lunch preparations to attend to
findings.explanation: The alternate branch repeats the narrowing of lunch preparation to cooking.

findings.highlight: You do that
findings.evidenceJa: お昼、よろしく頼む
findings.governingReading: he asks Sakura to take care of lunch
findings.explanation: Shirou’s polite reliance on Sakura becomes a curt instruction.

findings.highlight: She closes the shouji
findings.evidenceJa: ぱたり、と障子が閉まる
findings.governingReading: the shouji closes with a light patari sound
findings.explanation: The alternate branch again omits the small closing sound.

findings.highlight: a warm smile
findings.evidenceJa: いつもの柔らかい笑顔
findings.governingReading: her usual gentle, soft smile
findings.explanation: The English substitutes warmth and removes that this is Sakura’s familiar expression, weakening the contrast with the cold-footstep branch.
